description:
Wire all prompt composition sources (opi-u6a.1–5) into the session bootstrap.

Upstream integration point (agent-session.ts _rebuildSystemPrompt):
  const loadedContextFiles = resourceLoader.getAgentsFiles().agentsFiles;
  const loadedSkills = resourceLoader.getSkills().skills;
  const loaderSystemPrompt = resourceLoader.getSystemPrompt();   // nil = use default
  const appendParts = resourceLoader.getAppendSystemPrompt();    // []
  const appendSystemPrompt = parts.length > 0 ? parts.join("\n\n") : undefined;

  buildSystemPrompt({ cwd, skills, contextFiles, customPrompt, appendSystemPrompt, ... })

Implementation:
- New module: OctoPi.Coder.ResourceLoader
- Struct with: cwd, context_files, system_prompt, append_system_prompt, skills, prompt_templates
- load/1 — runs all sub-loaders and returns populated struct
- Wire into OctoPi.Coder.Coder.session_opts/1 (or wherever sessions are created)
- Wire into CLI interactive mode + print mode
- Add context_files, skills, custom_prompt, append opts to session creation in cli.ex

Tests (integration):
- ResourceLoader.load with real temp filesystem showing all sources combined
- Context files from ancestor
- Skills from project dir
- System prompt file takes effect
- Append prompt file appended
- All combined into correct SystemPrompt.render/1 call

Depends on: opi-u6a.1, opi-u6a.2, opi-u6a.3, opi-u6a.4, opi-u6a.5
